sources.system: Louisiana Board of Regents EMPSAL (Employee Salary Data System)
sources.institutions_covered: all public higher education institutions and systems (LSU, ULS, Southern, LCTCS)
sources.employees: all compensated personnel at a point in time
sources.format: internal data collection; only PDF specs public
fields: per spec: employee identifier, institution, position, salary, FTE etc. (not public)
sources.notes: Person-level data exists centrally at Regents but is not published; contact Regents Data Services Helpdesk (225-342-4253) or file a public records request - best single target for a records request. Direct curl got 403 (WAF); WebFetch read the page.

sources.system: LSU Digital Commons - 'Salaries of Louisiana State University Employees' collection
sources.notes: Collection page exists but lists no items.

sources.institution: LSU, Southern, ULS universities and other Louisiana public employers
sources.institutions_covered: includes LSU and Southern University employees
sources.blocker: Capped paged views (top 10,000) and per-person pages; no bulk download without account/request.
sources.notes: OpenPayrolls.com also has per-person LSU 2025 pages (e.g. https://openpayrolls.com/shane-stadler-175837775); provenance unverified.

gaps: No official published person-level pay for any Louisiana public university system or LCTCS. Regents EMPSAL holds the data but does not publish it. Checkbook coverage of higher ed unconfirmed and robots-blocked.
notes: Honored checkbook.la.gov robots.txt (Disallow /stateEmployees/). lailluminator.com returned 403, so Illuminator details come from search snippets. Did not check each ULS campus individually; LSU's own site only publishes aggregate peer-salary PDFs.
